text: By 2050, many experts believe we will have general AI, also known as AGI. Unlike today’s narrow AI, which can only perform specific tasks, AGI would think and learn across many different areas, much like a human. The potential benefits are enormous: AGI could solve complex problems in medicine, climate change, and education, making our lives safer and more efficient. However, there are real risks, such as job loss on a massive scale and the possibility of losing control over such a powerful system. While some predict AGI within a decade, others say it may take much longer. Either way, careful planning will be essential to ensure it helps humanity rather than harms it.
